title: The inventory of the launch contract, with the judgment exchange
description: The record `inventory` of the launch contract (feature 107): the tasks, the shell candidates, the prerequisite candidates and the verification documents of the deterministic inventory (F107-FR-004), and the record `judgment` of the exchange `specstride.judgment/1`, which the first `--next-batch` writes and no plain `contract derive` writes (F107-FR-009); it is the only state of the exchange. The member names are those of the baseline (data-model.md, "Member names"); `judgment` is new and its members are the ones data-model.md names in words. The members of `kind` of an item are the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 259 (`kindsOfJudgmentItem`), the ids of its choices and the choice of an answer are members of row 285 (`choicesOfAJudgmentItem`), and the route of an answer is a member of row 260 (`routeOfAnAnswerToAJudgmentItem`); all read from @specstride/contracts, never copied by hand.
x-annex: feature 107, data-model.md, "Member names" (the inventory with inventory.judgment)

tasks.description: Every task of the task lists, read by the canonical spec model (EP-03)

id.description: The id of the task, as the task line names it

phase.description: The number of the phase the task stands in; null for a task in no phase

line.description: The line of the task in its source

checked.description: Whether the checkbox of the task is ticked

parallel_marker.description: Whether the task line carries the marker [P]

story.description: The story the line names in brackets; null where it names none

text.description: The text of the task line after the id and the markers

source.description: The path of the task list, relative to the repository root

shell_candidates.description: The shell candidates of the plan and the quickstart only, with the reading of fences of the baseline, line by line, its accident included (F107-FR-004)

path.description: The path of the source that holds the block

start_line.description: The first line of the body: the line after the opening fence

end_line.description: The last line of the body: the line before the closing fence

text.description: The text of the body, trimmed

classification.description: The classification that keeps a candidate from becoming a command

prerequisites.description: The prerequisite candidates of every Markdown source (F107-FR-004)

id.description: The id the line carries; null where the line carries none

path.description: The path the backticked token writes

resolved.description: The path resolved against the repository root

present.description: Whether the resolved path is there

verification_documents.description: The record for the verification-commands document of each source that names one (F107-FR-004)

valid_json.description: Whether the document is a JSON object

error.description: The error, where the document cannot be read

feature.description: The feature the document names; null where it names none

phase_map.description: The phase map the document holds; null where it holds none

judgment.description: The state of the judgment exchange `specstride.judgment/1`: the items, the batch of each and the answers, kept in the draft itself (F107-FR-009). Written by the first `--next-batch`; a draft of a plain `contract derive` holds no such member (a rule of validation)

items.description: The items of the exchange; the number depends on the distinct questions of the sources, never on the number of tasks

kind.description: The kind of the item; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 259 (kindsOfJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts)

anchor.description: The source anchor: the task id, the id of the prerequisite, the id of the command or the line of the blocker

anyOf.description: The literal members of the closed set
The parameterized member `specstride-phase:<n>` of the closed set, n the number of a phase

items.description: A member of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 285 (choicesOfAJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts), the literal members as their enum and the parameterized member as its pattern

choices.description: The ids of the choices the item offers; members of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 285 (choicesOfAJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts)

batch_id.description: The id of the batch the item stands in

question.description: The question the item asks, as the derivation wrote it

excerpt.description: The excerpt of the source the item stands for

source.description: The source the item was read from (path and line)

answers.description: The answers recorded in the exchange, each with its provenance

item.description: The id of the item the answer is to

anyOf.description: The literal members of the closed set
The parameterized member `specstride-phase:<n>` of the closed set, n the number of a phase

choice.description: The id of the choice the answer is; a member of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 285 (choicesOfAJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts), the literal members as their enum and the parameterized member as its pattern

provenance.description: Who answered, how, and in which batch (F107-FR-010, F107-FR-011)

who.description: The host or the harness that answered

route.description: The route of the answer; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 260 (routeOfAnAnswerToAJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts)

harness.description: The named harness of a delegated answer; null for the host model

batch.description: The id of the batch the answer closed

settled.description: The ids of the obligations and findings the answer settled
